automation.empty.heading.note: Empty-state heading on an admin page that has no data yet.

automation.empty.body.note: Empty-state explanation, one or two sentences.

automation.checkoutLock.message.note: Checkout error shown to shoppers who are not buying for an approved B2B company when the store is wholesale-only. Shown at checkout by Shopify.

automation.settings.heading.note: Section heading on the Automation page.

automation.settings.paused.note: Switch label. When on, no rule approves or rejects anything.

automation.settings.pausedHelp.note: Help text under the Pause all automation switch.

automation.settings.dailyLimit.note: Number field label: daily cap on auto-approvals.

automation.settings.dailyLimitHelp.note: Help text under the daily limit field. {count} = auto-approvals today.

automation.rules.heading.note: Section heading for the list of automation rules.

automation.rules.body.note: Explains rule order on the Automation page.

automation.rules.noTiers.note: Warning when no tier exists yet.

automation.rules.addApprove.note: Button that adds an auto-approve rule.

automation.rules.addReject.note: Button that adds an auto-reject rule.

automation.rule.approveTitle.note: Heading of one auto-approve rule card. {number} = position.

automation.rule.rejectTitle.note: Heading of one auto-reject rule card. {number} = position.

automation.rule.enabled.note: Switch label to turn a single rule on or off.

automation.rule.remove.note: Button that removes a rule (saved only when the merchant saves).

automation.rule.removeLabel.note: Accessible label for the remove-rule button. {rule} = rule title.

automation.rule.match.note: Select label: whether all or any conditions must match.

automation.rule.matchAny.note: Option: one matching condition is enough.

automation.rule.addCondition.note: Button that adds a condition to a rule.

automation.condition.type.note: Select label for the condition type.

automation.condition.business_type.note: Condition type: business type chosen on the form.

automation.condition.email_domain.note: Condition type: the part of the email after @.

automation.condition.tax_verified.note: Condition type: the tax/VAT number was verified with an official registry.

automation.condition.certificate_uploade.note: Condition type: the applicant uploaded a certificate.

automation.condition.custom_field.note: Condition type: a form field has a given answer.

automation.condition.spam.note: Condition type: the application was flagged as possible spam.

automation.condition.is.note: Operator option, e.g. Country is US.

automation.condition.isNot.note: Operator option, e.g. Country is not US.

automation.condition.values.country.note: Text field label for a comma-separated list of 2-letter country codes.

automation.condition.values.business_typ.note: Text field label for a comma-separated list of business types.

automation.condition.values.email_domain.note: Text field label for a comma-separated list of domains like example.com.

automation.condition.valuesHelp.note: Help text under a list-of-values field.

automation.condition.field.note: Text field label: the form field to check (e.g. custom_1).

automation.condition.equals.note: Text field label: the answer the field must have.

automation.condition.removeLabel.note: Accessible label of the remove-condition button.

automation.action.tier.note: Select label: which tier auto-approved buyers go to.

automation.action.chooseTier.note: Empty option of the tier select.

automation.action.terms.note: Select label for payment terms on auto-approval.

automation.action.tierTerms.note: Default option: take payment terms from the tier.

automation.action.reason.note: Text area label: reason included in the rejection email.

automation.action.reasonHelp.note: Help text under the reason field.

automation.error.summary.note: Error summary banner heading at the top of the Automation page.

automation.error.conditions_required.note: Inline error: rule has no conditions.

automation.error.values_required.note: Inline error: list condition is empty.

automation.error.tier_required.note: Inline error: approval rule without tier.

automation.error.dailyLimit.note: Inline error under the daily limit field. {max} = 500.

automation.recent.heading.note: Section heading: applications decided by rules.

automation.recent.none.note: Empty text for the automatic decisions list.

automation.recent.when.note: Table column header: when the decision was made.

automation.recent.status.other.note: Badge: rule matched but the application is still open (for example the approval stopped).

automation.recent.reverse.note: Button that undoes an automatic decision.

automation.recent.reversed.undone.note: Toast after reversing a partial auto-approval.

automation.recent.reversed.paused.note: Toast after reversing a finished auto-approval.

automation.reverse.approvedBody.note: Modal body when reversing an auto-approval.

automation.reverse.rejectedBody.note: Modal body when reversing an auto-rejection.

automation.reverse.confirm.note: Primary (destructive) button in the reverse modal.

automation.flow.open.note: Button linking to the Flow app.
